correctness.rationale: For every integer d>=3, positive definiteness is exactly Walsh nonnegativity. The radialization keeps the objective and yields an explicit degree-three Krawtchouk polynomial. The displayed positive combinations of Fourier-layer values give exact upper bounds 2d+2 (odd) and 2d (even), while explicit nonnegative cubic Walsh spectra attain them and have Walsh average one, proving the unrestricted sharp constant. At odd d>=5, equality forces zeros on both central layers and at all-negative signs; the two-slice kernel lemma is proved by inclusion-matrix rank induction for d>=7 and explicit slice interpolation at d=5. Factoring the Walsh polynomial and testing one-positive-sign vertices proves all coefficients b_i>=0, their required sum, and injective simplex completeness. At d=3 positivity gives unique constant-one solution. For even d>=4, radiality, required zeros and positivity at S=2,-2 yield exactly the alpha interval [-2,2]. Exact checker reproduces 49 rational Walsh constructions at d=3..11, dual identities, and modular nullities d at odd d=5,7,9; this is supporting computation, not an infinite proof. No all-even nonradial classification claimed.
